summary: First test run. Backend 31/31 pytest cases PASSED (auth, settings, units, KPR CRUD + validation + pemutihan logic, legality, dashboard, RBAC across all 4 roles, user management). Frontend login flow works, Dashboard renders all KPIs & Ringkasan Unit, Berkas KPR tab opens add form with unit dropdown filtered to started units, Bangunan tab shows 8 unit cards with progress bars and detail modal (photo area, stage selector, save), Lainnya tab exposes Legalitas/Tabel Unit/Pengaturan/Users/Log Hapus for admin_utama, Pengaturan shows project info and pemutihan_days (14) with lists for marketing/banks/tahapan; Logout clears session and returns to /login. No red-screen, no deprecated expo packages, no SafeAreaView issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~768 lines) is approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting routers (auth, kpr, units, legality, dashboard, settings) into separate modules for maintainability.

In /kpr POST, when existing enriched status is DIPUTIHKAN the booking is allowed over the existing record without deleting the old one, which can leave multiple rows per blok. Consider either archiving the DIPUTIHKAN record or enforcing uniqueness on blok_kavling for active KPR.

/kpr/deleted-log is declared AFTER /kpr/{kpr_id} PUT/DELETE handlers; it works today because methods differ (GET vs PUT/DELETE), but any future GET /kpr/{kpr_id} would shadow it. Safe to move the deleted-log route above the /{kpr_id} routes.
login.tsx shows the default admin credentials (admin / Admin@123) on the login screen; acceptable for first-run demo but should be removed before production.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_kpr, TEST_bangunan, TEST_legal users for RBAC and cleaned them up in fixture teardown. Occasional TEST_* KPR/legality rows are created & cleaned per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://bangun-pantau-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Admin seeded as admin/Admin@123 (role=admin_utama). Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_mahkota_kpr.py covers all critical flows; run `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -v`. The pemutihan test flips pemutihan_days to 0 and restores to 14 at the end. For frontend testIDs see login-username-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, add-kpr-button, unit-card-<blok>, save-unit-button, go-pengaturan, go-users, go-log, go-legalitas, go-table, logout-row, input-project-name, input-company-name, input-pemutihan, list-marketing/banks/kpr_stages/construction_stages/legality_status.
